1) chief, ruler, commander

strongs_1890.strongs_def: a magistrate (as deciding) or other leader
strongs_1890.derivation: from H7096 (קָצָה) in the sense of determining;
strongs_1890.kjv_def: captain, guide, prince, ruler. Compare H6278 (עֵת קָצִין).
